info.brief: A chainable wrapper around a game object. `new` stores a url, and each method calls the
info.description:
A chainable wrapper around a game object. `new` stores a url, and each method calls the
`go.*` function of the same name with that url: setters return the wrapper, so calls
chain, and getters return what the engine does.

functions.description:

functions.name: delete
functions.brief: Deletes the game object with `go.delete`. At `1.1.0` the deletion is always
functions.description:
Deletes the game object with `go.delete`. At `1.1.0` the deletion is always
recursive: upstream reads `recursive or true`, so `false` still deletes the children.

parameters.name: recursive
parameters.doc: Whether to delete the children as well.

parameters.doc: An easing constant, or a vector of easing samples.

functions.name: animate
functions.brief: Animates several properties with `go.animate`, each to the value at the same index
functions.description:
Animates several properties with `go.animate`, each to the value at the same index
of `to`, all with the same playback, easing, duration and delay.

parameters.name: to
parameters.doc: The value to animate each property to, by index.

parameters.name: easing
parameters.doc: An easing constant, or a vector of easing samples.

parameters.name: delay
parameters.doc: The delay in seconds before the animations start. Defaults to `0`.

parameters.name: complete_function
parameters.doc: Called once the first property's animation completes.
types: (self: unknown, url: Url, property: Hash) => void

functions.name: cancel_animations

functions.description: Cancels the game object's animations with `go.cancel_animations`.

parameters.name: property
parameters.doc:
The property, or the properties, whose animations to cancel. When
omitted, every animation of the game object is canceled.
